claims.claim: Movement observation begins with what can be seen: task, starting position, joint motion, timing and conditions. A description differs from a judgement about normality or injury. People vary in anatomy, experience and task strategy. A video cannot directly reveal tissue forces, pain causes or medical diagnoses. Use observations to ask useful questions and seek qualified guidance where needed; do not require painful or high-load demonstrations.

locators.limitations: Simplified lever models, not exact tissue forces
